show.description: Thrown out of their billionaire father’s empire, twin brothers Ajay and Arjun choose opposite paths in life. While Arjun fights for success with love and loyalty, Ajay embraces betrayal and revenge. As love, revenge, and family secrets collide, the battle between the identical brothers turns into a deadly war where only one can claim the throne.
